question: Does changing only the Gunicorn module entrypoint on the same deployed app produce HTTP 5xx and a matching import error, then recover when reverted?
scope: Dedicated Linux B1 App Service, Python 3.11, public HTTPS endpoint, one app and one Log Analytics workspace
criteria: Ordered healthy HTTP 200 baseline, fault HTTP 5xx and same-resource fault-window ModuleNotFoundError containing wrong_module, recovered HTTP 200; transport failure alone is INCONCLUSIVE
sampling: Up to 24 health probes per phase, 20 second request timeout, 10 second interval; six log queries with 60 second timeout and 30 second interval
exclusions: No rows excluded by the evaluator; any wrong-resource or out-of-window row fails integrity
cleanup: Explicit cleanup command for the dedicated resource group; poll until group exists is false
